text: Let's collect the [ffff64]stolen boxes[ffffff] before you proceed!
Whoa~...The illumination is so pretty...\nBut, what is this weird feeling...?\nDon't you feel it too?
My gosh! W-w-w-what is this?!\nNo one ever told me that the light ornaments can\nmove!!
The good news is we've managed to get away,\nbut how are we gonna restore Velly to normal now?
We won't stand a chance if she attacks us with the\nanti-Xmas energy that has become so powerful, you\nknow?
I...I didn't know that Santa's job would be this\ntiring...
Hey, hey, what makes you so tired?
After I switched power with Velly and gained Xmas\nenergy, my body just started to help the\nXmas knights automatically when they asked me...
I couldn't turn them down although I wanted to.\nThen they dragged me around to give out presents\nas Santa...
Especially that female Xmas knight called Nicola!\nShe kept ordering me around because she knew\nI couldn't say no...I've reached my limit...
Oh, Santa! The presents we got from you earlier\ngot taken away by monsters~!
Please, give me present one more time!\nBoo-hoo, boo-hoo-hoo-hoooo!
Hey! Now you're Santa Claus, you know!!\nDon't you ruin these children's dreams!
Ouch! Ouch?!\nBut still, I won't do what I don't wanna do!!
Um...? Hey, the Xmas presents are made with\nXmas energy, right?
So, is it not possible to use the power of the\npresents to weaken Velly's anti-Xmas energy that\nhas become powerful?
That might be possible...\nA-anyway, get off me already, you're heavy...
Did you hear that? We need to kill those and\ncollect the stolen presents!
Hey, we wanna see how you get those presents back!!
Hmm...I kinda wanna take them too, but the\nanti-Xmas energy is getting stronger...
You might get hurt during the fight, so please\njust wait at your own home, okay?
It's okay!\nWe'll get back the presents and give them to you\nonce again. I promise!!
After sending the children home, just go back to\nNavida City.\nUndertand?!
Whaaat?! Why do I have to send them home tho...?\nBesides, why do you want me to go back to\nNavida...?
Because you're Santa now, aren't you?\nSo you should escort them home safely.
And if you don't go back to Navida City, how can\nyou switch back your power with Velly? You'll be\nSanta forever, or do you actually prefer that?
Whaat?! I, I wouldn't want that!!\nA-all right, I'll return to Navida later...
Okay everyone, Santa just said that he'd send\nyou all home!
Please select the difficulty to enter.
